glance.summary: Nvidia paused server shipments to Southeast Asia to comply with U.S. chip restrictions.
Forty-two state attorneys general are acting to stop Character.AI from selling user chat histories.
SAP is considering eliminating 10,000 jobs as leadership sees AI permanently reducing labor needs.
Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO following discussions involving U.S. President Donald Trump.

big_pour.headline: State AGs fight Character.AI chat sale
big_pour.summary: A coalition of 42 state attorneys general is trying to prevent Character.AI from selling user chat histories from over 21 million U.S. accounts in Chapter 11 bankruptcy.
big_pour.why: If you use Character.AI, state AGs are working to prevent your private chats from being sold.

explain.kid: Character.AI is in bankruptcy court, and state leaders are trying to stop the company from selling 21 million people's private chat messages.
explain.pm: Forty-two state attorneys general filed to prevent Character.AI from selling user data, specifically private chat histories from 21 million U.S. accounts, as part of Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings.
explain.engineer: As Character.AI undergoes Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings, 42 state AGs are attempting to stop the auction of private chat histories from more than 21 million U.S. accounts.

big_pour.headline: Nvidia pauses server shipments to Southeast Asia
big_pour.summary: Nvidia told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens efforts to keep AI chips out of China.

big_pour.headline: S&P weighs Nvidia credit rating downgrade
big_pour.summary: Credit rating agency S&P may lower Nvidia's credit rating to AA- over concerns regarding governance and key man risks.

office_blend.headline: Atlanta airport explores physical AI with cameras
office_blend.summary: Chris Crist, the chief information officer at Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport, discussed how physical AI and seven thousand cameras can help locate someone who dropped a bag.

office_blend.headline: Ally Financial updates customer personas with AI
office_blend.summary: UX designers and content teams at Ally Financial use agentic AI to reinvent customer personas to predict how consumers respond to digital services.

still_roasting.summary: Nothing detailed its Ear Note AI earbuds and charging case, which can record and summarize conversations, ahead of their December 8th release.
Tidal will ban AI-generated music starting December 9th, deleting around 29 million songs and rejecting up to 85,000 tracks daily.

quick_sips.summary: Anthropic's Claude was used by security researchers to reach OpenAI's internal code systems in under three days.
Amazon Bedrock launched a Trusted Access API preview providing enterprise data controls for Anthropic's Claude models.
Google had its patent rejected for My Channel, a system designed to generate personalized AI video feeds.

stories.label: New model
stories.headline: JetBrains launches Mellum model for fast edits
stories.summary: JetBrains launched an open-source Mellum coding model variant that uses 45% fewer tokens by skipping thinking steps during quick code edits.

stories.label: Case study
stories.headline: Confluent restarts AI rewrite of Kafka client
stories.summary: Confluent spent nearly three months using AI coding agents to translate Apache Kafka's Java client into Rust before starting over.

concept.explanation: In JetBrains' announcement, tokens refer to the processing metric for its open source Mellum coding model, which reduced token usage by 45% for quick code edits by skipping thinking steps.

long_read.headline: How Anthropic builds software in 2026
long_read.summary: The newsletter shares Katelyn Lesse explaining how Anthropic rewrote Claude’s API in Rust and how AI agents are changing engineering at the company.

sign_off: That's the last sip. See you next morning.
